brief.title: Price history: serve bounded historical reads
brief.description: A chart page asks for eight preloaded price records for one product. Deliver that bounded history read during app loss and concentrated traffic. Wide historical reads do real database work; more app concurrency cannot make the database unlimited. Choose each app's cores, workers and queue. The private assessment checks delivery, errors, completed-request latency and fault survival. Fault survival uses delivered caller outcomes during the outage, not a health label. All offers are in [10000,70000) us; observe terminals through 100000 us. Hidden variants change burst shape, keys and failed app within the stated domain. Timing is assumption-only. Supported subtotal and full cost are Unknown.
exclusions: Price ingestion and live market feeds
alerts, scheduling and external provider behavior
time-series compression, arbitrary SQL or financial correctness
calibrated cloud timing and complete resident memory
supported cost subtotal and full cost

constraints.topology: fixed load balancer, two application processes and one relational DB; no cache
constraints.domain: 24..32 history-page calls; 8 recorded keys per call; 0..1000 us within-wave spacing; one app crash at 3000..6000 us for 68000..74000 us, recovery 3000..6000 us; all offers in [10000,70000) us, terminals through 100000 us. Synthetic assumptions only.
